sentences.en: The company has noticed a rise in absenteeism lately.
sentences.zh: 公司最近注意到旷工有所增加。

sentences.en: Reducing absenteeism is one of our main goals this year.
sentences.zh: 减少旷工是今年我们的重要目标之一。

sentences.en: The school principal discussed the issue of student absenteeism with teachers.
sentences.zh: 校长与老师们讨论了学生旷课的问题。

senses.zh: 旷工,旷课 - 在外地主经济制；(地主、业主的)长期在外
